about: Tested versions of the Mizzey stack. Evidence for these versions only, not a production compatibility guarantee. Change only through the regression path in docs/stack-and-upgrades.md. corex.lock remains the file tools/corex-sync.mjs reads; the corex entry here must match it (checked by tools/repo_checks.py).
verified_in: local disposable runtime ../app/wp built by tools/corex-sync.mjs (WAMP, Windows)

database.source: SELECT VERSION() in the disposable runtime ../app/wp returned 8.3.0 on 2026-10-04; local WAMP also ships MariaDB 11.3.2, which the runtime does not use
database.notes: Every discovery probe and every product-cost integration scenario ran against this engine. The production engine is set with hosting (OD-27)

wordpress.notes: corex.lock pins the 7.1 line and tools/corex-sync.mjs installs from it. The runtime observed on 2026-10-04 reports 7.1.2, WordPress having applied its own patch update. Recording 7.1.2 in this file requires corex.lock to change with it, because tools/repo_checks.py compares the two exactly, and corex.lock is a version-lock path the governance category may not touch (PATH_POLICY in tools/scope_trace.py). Escalated rather than worked around: see the PR body
